collection.title: Citroen BX 1982 to 1994 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen BX Hatchback 1986 to 1994 model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this BX, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
